prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1418; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating from the occipital region. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in extension and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no focal deficits, and imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings.

Over the course of treatment, the patient attended 26 visits. Care consisted of a combination of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise targeting cervical stabilization, and modalities for pain control. Symptoms improved gradually, with headache frequency decreasing and cervical range of motion approaching functional norms by the later part of the treatment period.

At the time of discharge, the patient reported residual mild neck stiffness with activity but was able to perform daily work and household tasks without significant limitation. A home exercise program was provided, and the patient was advised to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
